newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian shares fall in dull trade.
newsitem.headline: Estonian shares fall in dull trade.

text.p: The Estonian stock market was dull on Tuesday with the index falling during the last, shortened trading session of 1996, dealers said.
The official list turned over some 15.2 million kroons and the index fell 0.29 percent to 160.32.
Shares of market leader Hansapank were the most traded with trade worth 2.5 million kroons, but the stock closed lower at 55.85 kroons against 56.80.
Union bank closed 0.85 kroons higher at 29 kroons as shares worth 1.2 million kroons changed hands.
The over-the-counter market traded some 2.8 million kroons and Tallinna Kaubamaja department store had volume of 1.1 million kroons to close slightly lower at 75.75 kroons versus 76.
